tagline: Insect protein feed production for poultry and aquaculture farmers
problem: Poultry farmers spend 75% of operating costs on imported soy and fishmeal feed, leaving small farmers vulnerable to currency shocks.
solution: We culture black soldier fly larvae fed on organic brewery and market waste to create 100% organic, 40% cheaper high-protein feed.
traction: Supplying 12 poultry farms in Kumasi, producing 850kg feed monthly, GH₵6,200 revenue last month.

tagline: Decentralized AI micro-grids for off-grid communities and rural agri-hubs
coFounders: Tariq Mansoor (CTO, ex-Schneider Electric), Amina Bello (Hardware Lead)
problem: Over 600 million people lack access to dependable electricity, crippling agricultural cold-chains and causing 40% harvest spoilage.

tagline: Ultralow-bandwidth AI pathology diagnostics for decentralized clinics
coFounders: Kevin Ochieng (AI Lead, PhD Bioengineering), Faith Mutua (Ops)
problem: Diagnostic bottlenecks in rural clinics delay acute disease detection by up to 3 weeks, resulting in preventable mortality.
solution: Edge-computed computer vision model attached to standard optical microscopes that identifies bloodborne parasites in under 90 seconds offline.
targetAudience: Tier 2 and Tier 3 public and private clinics, humanitarian NGO field medical teams.
traction: Contracted with 14 community clinics; 8,200+ samples processed with 97.8% clinical concordance; $14,000 ARR.
businessModel: SaaS per-test fee ($0.40) or flat annual clinic license ($1,200/yr).
